# MessageActions

Actions under a message: copy, retry, like and dislike, plus your own icon buttons. Each button has a tooltip and
an accessible name; like and dislike are toggle buttons (`aria-pressed`) that exclude each other.

**Interaction**: the group is a toolbar with a single `Tab` stop: `←` / `→` move between the buttons, `Home` /
`End` go to the first and the last, and `Tab` leaves the toolbar; coming back, focus returns to the button used
last. Copying shows a check mark and announces "Copied" (CopyButton). Inside Message, the toolbar appears on hover
or when keyboard focus enters the message.

**Category**: AI · **Common uses**: Copy, retry and rate an AI reply; actions of a chat message

## Import

```ts
import { MessageActions } from 'vellum-ui'
```

## Basic usage

Copy, retry, like and dislike. Like and dislike exclude each other, and pressing the pressed one again clears
it. The group has one `Tab` stop; `←` / `→` move between the buttons.

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { MessageActions, type MessageFeedback, Stack, Text } from 'vellum-ui'

const REPLY = 'The release is planned for Thursday at 10:00.'

export function Basic() {
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = useState<MessageFeedback>(null)
  return (
    <Stack gap={2} align="start">
      <MessageActions
        copyText={REPLY}
        onRetry={() => {}}
        feedback={feedback}
        onFeedbackChange={setFeedback}
      />
      <Text tone="tertiary" size="sm">
        Feedback: {feedback ?? 'none'}
      </Text>
    </Stack>
  )
}
```

## Advanced

### Your own actions

Icon buttons passed as children come after the built-in ones and take part in the arrow key navigation.

```tsx
import { IconButton, MessageActions } from 'vellum-ui'

const REPLY = 'The release is planned for Thursday at 10:00.'

export function CustomActions() {
  return (
    <MessageActions copyText={REPLY}>
      <IconButton icon="share" size="sm" label="Share" onClick={() => {}} />
      <IconButton icon="more" size="sm" label="More" onClick={() => {}} />
    </MessageActions>
  )
}
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `copyText` | `string` | The text copied by the "Copy" button, usually the plain text or Markdown source of the message. The button is shown only when it is set. | — | No |
| `onCopy` | `(text: string) => void` | Called after the text has been written to the clipboard. | — | No |
| `onCopyError` | `(error: unknown) => void` | Called when copying fails (see CopyButton); without it the error is reported with `reportError`. | — | No |
| `onRetry` | `() => void` | Shows a "Retry" button that calls this function, for example to generate the reply again. | — | No |
| `feedback` | `'like' \| 'dislike' \| null` | The current feedback (controlled). Without it the buttons keep their own state, starting with none. | — | No |
| `onFeedbackChange` | `(feedback: MessageFeedback) => void` | Shows the "Like" and "Dislike" toggle buttons; called with the new feedback. Pressing the pressed button again clears it (`null`); the two buttons exclude each other. | — | No |
| `label` | `string` | Accessible name of the toolbar; "Message actions" by default. | — | No |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | Your own actions after the built-in ones, usually IconButton with `size="sm"`. They take part in the arrow key navigation. | — | No |

Also accepts `testId` (rendered as `data-testid`), `aria-label`, `role` and `id`, like all primitives.

Does not accept `style` or `className`: appearance is adjusted only through the semantic props above and the theme.

## Types

Types of this library used above. Import them with `import type { … } from 'vellum-ui'`.

### MessageFeedback

Feedback on a message: `like`, `dislike`, or `null` for none.

```ts
type MessageFeedback = 'like' | 'dislike' | null
```
